title: Withdraw Unstakes ALL Shares - Gas Griefing Vector
description: The `withdraw()` function unstakes ALL mainRewarder shares regardless of the actual withdrawal size, then re-stakes the remainder. This causes gas costs to scale with total TVL rather than the withdrawal amount.
impact: Gas costs scale with total TVL, not withdrawal size. Small withdrawals become disproportionately expensive. This creates a griefing vector where attackers can force users to pay excessive gas fees.
attackPath: Protocol has large TVL staked in mainRewarder
Function unstakes ALL shares (expensive operation proportional to TVL)
Function re-stakes the remainder (another expensive operation)
User pays gas proportional to total TVL, not their withdrawal amount
codeSnippet: // withdraw() unstakes ALL shares regardless of withdrawal size, then re-stakes remainder
recommendation: Calculate and unstake only the proportional shares needed for the withdrawal amount, avoiding the expensive unstake-all-and-restake pattern.
